items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I learned a lot of stuff from him, talking about music and talking about playing and this is how you do this and that. I learned a lot.

ctx.x: Well the accents in the British Isles are very regional. You know you can, even in London there’s about four or five completely different accents you know. North London is completely different from South London. And I mean you wouldn’t really sort of think about that until you actually live there and you can hear the difference. And this, in Scotland, when I went to Glasgow, that was a big traumatic experience for me. And I started playing little bits of jazz and going to jazz clubs and I had a gig in a night…
Do they have too much knowledge and no place to use it?
